name: ProtocolQA Open-Ended
intro: ProtocolQA Open-Ended是OpenAI在o1系统卡中披露的开放式湿实验故障排除评测。它把FutureHouse ProtocolQA中的108道多项选择题改写为简答题，保留常见已发表实验方案中的严重错误与观察到的实验结果，并要求模型说明如何修复流程。
build_method: 从FutureHouse ProtocolQA选择108题，移除选项并改写为开放式湿实验故障排除简答题
task_type: 开放式问答, 生物安全评测
eval_feature: 开放式简答、单次尝试通过率，并与19名具有一年以上湿实验经验的博士科学家基线比较
build_method_en: Select 108 FutureHouse ProtocolQA items, remove answer options, and rewrite them as open-ended short-answer wet-lab troubleshooting questions
eval_feature_en: Open-ended short answers, one-attempt pass rate, and comparison with 19 PhD scientists who each have more than one year of wet-lab experience
intro_en: ProtocolQA Open-Ended is an open-ended wet-lab troubleshooting evaluation disclosed in OpenAI's o1 System Card. It converts 108 multiple-choice questions from FutureHouse ProtocolQA into short-answer tasks, preserving egregious errors in common published protocols and the observed wet-lab result, then asks how to fix the procedure.
drawio_review_note: 2026-07-14：已按OpenAI o1系统卡与原始LAB-Bench论文核对108题来源、选择题到开放简答改写、严重方案错误、实验结果与修复问题、pass@1、19名博士湿实验专家及57%共识/42%中位数基线；系统卡未披露该评测评分器实现细节，图中明确保留这一边界，并完成中英文视觉与拓扑复核。
